quotes: You must submit your change of address request and verify your identity. Once your request is approved, allow at least 7-10 business days for it to go into effect.
First-Class Mail® is forwarded for free.
Priority Mail Express®, Priority Mail®, and USPS Ground Advantage® items are forwarded for free.
Periodicals (newsletters and magazines) are forwarded for free for 60 days if fully prepaid by the sender.
Media Mail® items are forwarded, but you must pay the cost for shipping from your local Post Office™ location to your new address.

For security, mailers like government agencies and financial institutions do not allow forwarding of sensitive documents, including: Identity documents, especially driver's licenses and voter registration; Credit cards, bank statements, insurance info, and other financial or medical information
USPS Marketing Mail® is not forwarded unless the sender has paid forwarding postage.

Your change of address order only changes your mailing address with the Post Office. You are responsible for telling government agencies, companies, and any other senders that your address has changed.
Pay the $1.25 identity verification fee. The billing address on your credit card must match either your old or new address.
If your online identity verification succeeds: USPS will email you a confirmation code. Use this code if you need to modify or cancel your request.
About 5 business days before your change of address start date, you'll get a Customer Notification Letter (with your confirmation code) to your "new" address.
Fill out the PS Form 3575 found inside the packet, and give it to the retail associate. They will use your photo ID to verify your identity, then process your change of address request.
Standard mail forwarding lasts 12 months. You can pay to extend mail forwarding for 6, 12, or 18 more months (18 months is the maximum).
Note: When your mail forwarding period ends, USPS will return your mail to the sender for 6 months with a label that has your new address.
If you're only relocating for 15 days up to 1 year (like going to school or staying with family or friends), submit a temporary change of address request.

There are third party websites that will charge you fees of $40.00 or more to submit your change of address. The Postal Service no longer accepts submissions from third party businesses due to updated authentication processes.
When the COA request is made online there is a $1.25 authentication fee.
A COA request can be submitted 90 days _before_ the effective date of your move, and up to 30 days _after_ the date of your move.
The minimum time period for temporary forwarding is 15 days.
Temporary COAs, or seasonal forwarding, provide forwarding of mail to a temporary address for a maximum of 364 days, starting with the listed start date.
Temporary COAs provide forwarding of mail to a temporary address for a maximum of 185 days. A new request can be filed extending the temporary COA for up to an additional 179 days.
The total forwarding time on a temporary move cannot exceed 12 months.
If you return to the original address for a minimum of 45 days, the 364 day forwarding limit starts over, allowing you to submit a new Temporary COA order.
First-Class Mail® / USPS Ground Advantage® / Priority Mail® service (bills, invoices, personal correspondence, reply mail) | 12 months
Periodicals (magazines, newsletters) | 60 days
USPS Marketing Mail® (advertisements, catalogs, retail offers) | Only forwarded IF the mailer specifies forwarding instructions May be subject to postage due
The PS Form 3575 form can no longer be printed from your home computer.
It can be completed in a few steps, online at USPS.com, or by visiting one of more than 33,000 local Post Office™️ locations.
The Postal Service provides temporary forwarding service for a period of two weeks to six months (15 to 185 days) in response to an initial temporary change-of-address order.

Customers may extend the temporary forwarding period up to a maximum of 12 months (364 days), by filing a second change-of-address order to begin on the first day of the second six-month period (the 186th day)

A record of permanent change-of-address orders is kept by Post Offices for 18 months, from the end of the month when the change takes effect. Generally, forwarding is available for the first 12 months.

scope_rules.rule: Never say the COA 'changes your address'. USPS states it only changes your mailing address with the Post Office and forwards a subset of mail for a limited time.
scope_rules.reason: usps.com/manage/forward.htm: 'Your change of address order only changes your mailing address with the Post Office. You are responsible for telling government agencies, companies, and any other senders.'

scope_rules.rule: Never claim bank statements, credit cards, driver's licenses, or government ID are forwarded. USPS lists these as NOT forwarded for security.
Never claim USPS Marketing Mail is forwarded by default — only if the sender paid forwarding postage; may arrive postage due.
Never claim packages in general are forwarded. USPS forwarding covers its own mail classes; merchant shipments move on private carriers and never touch the COA.
scope_rules.reason: FAQ: COA covers 'primarily First-Class Mail service and Periodicals'; generally does not forward Package Services Mail.

scope_rules.rule: Never claim the paper form can be printed at home or downloaded — PS Form 3575 is only available in the Mover's Guide packet at a Post Office.
scope_rules.reason: FAQ: 'The PS Form 3575 form can no longer be printed from your home computer.'

scope_rules.rule: Mailbox Plus cannot file or submit your USPS change of address for you — the store is not a Post Office retail counter and PS Form 3575 is USPS-internal. Store role is the mailing address that does not move (PMB) plus receiving/forwarding of mail that arrives here.
scope_rules.reason: Never assert store services that do not exist (owner rule).

scope_rules.rule: No time-of-day scene opener; scene clock only inside the success section.
Location claims use approved phrasing only: 'just off Crile Road, minutes from SR-44 and I-90', 'Gristmill Village', 'next to Pub Frato'. Never Route 306.

required_when.qualifier: the 12-month forwarding period must always carry its mail classes: First-Class Mail, USPS Ground Advantage, Priority Mail (and Priority Mail Express)
required_when.reason: FAQ table scopes 12 months to those classes; Periodicals are 60 days.

required_when.qualifier: the $1.25 fee must be named 'identity verification / authentication fee for filing online' — in-person filing with PS Form 3575 is free
required_when.reason: FAQ: 'If you prefer not to use your credit card, you can fill out PS Form 3575 acquired from your local Post Office.'

required_when.qualifier: the $15 PMB price must be scoped 'personal plans start at' — business tiers differ
'sensitive mail is not forwarded' requires 'for security' framing and the fix 'contact the sender directly'
required_when.reason: USPS frames it as a security block, and directs customers to contact senders.
